The core problem: Model and feature availability are unstable. Experimental models cycle in and out. Fable 5 was made available, then withdrawn. Current access windows are 7 days, extended twice to 21 days total—which doesn’t align with actual development timelines. You cannot build sustainable workflows on rolling uncertainty.
